commit_message:
Make use of the flexible-array feature of C99, when available, to try to pacify -fsanitize=strict-bounds.  This check-in fixes the core. There is more yet to do in FTS3, RTREE, and in FTS5.

fix_commit.message: Fix an off-by-one error in the size computation of a vdbe-sorter. [forum:/forumpost/c1cc8b057a|Forum post c1cc8b057a]. Problem introduced by checkin [d4307a0d43f42e96].
fix_commit.author: drh

findings.title: Off-by-one under-computation of KeyInfo buffer size causes heap OOB read in sqlite3VdbeSorterInit
findings.message:
While refactoring VdbeSorter/KeyInfo to use C99 flexible array members, the size computation for the KeyInfo object that is embedded/copied after the VdbeSorter struct was changed from `sizeof(KeyInfo) + (nKeyField-1)*sizeof(CollSeq*)` to `SZ_KEYINFO(nKeyField+1)`, where `SZ_KEYINFO(N)` is defined as `offsetof(KeyInfo,aColl) + (N)*sizeof(CollSeq*)`. Because `KeyInfo.aColl` is now a flexible array (rather than a 1-element array whose first slot was already accounted for by `sizeof(KeyInfo)`), the correct size for `nKeyField` collating-sequence pointers is `SZ_KEYINFO(nKeyField)`. Passing `nKeyField+1` allocates and copies room for one extra `CollSeq*` slot than actually exists in the source `KeyInfo` object pointed to by `pCsr->pKeyInfo`.

Later, `sqlite3VdbeSorterInit()` calls `memcpy(pKeyInfo, pCsr->pKeyInfo, szKeyInfo)`, copying `szKeyInfo` bytes from `pCsr->pKeyInfo`, which is only sized for `nKeyField` entries. Since `szKeyInfo` was computed as if there were `nKeyField+1` entries, the memcpy reads past the end of the `pCsr->pKeyInfo` allocation, causing a heap-buffer-overflow read (confirmed by ASan; particularly visible when `SQLITE_DEFAULT_MEMSTATUS=0` removes extra allocator padding that normally masked the overread).
findings.suggestion: Compute szKeyInfo using the actual number of key fields, not nKeyField+1, since SZ_KEYINFO(N) with the new flexible-array-based offsetof formula already accounts for exactly N CollSeq* slots (unlike the old sizeof(KeyInfo)+(N-1)*sizeof(CollSeq*) formula which needed the -1 adjustment because sizeof(KeyInfo) already included one slot).

ground_truth.root_cause: A macro semantics change (from a 'size for N-1 extra elements beyond the first embedded one' formula to a 'size for exactly N elements from offsetof' formula) was not reflected correctly at one of its call sites; the call site retained an extra '+1' meant for the old formula, causing the size computation to request one more array element than actually exists in the source object being copied.
